proposals.title: Item 4— Shareholder Proposal on the Adoption of a Board Policy that the Chairperson of the Board be an Independent Director
proposals.proponent: The Sisters of St. Francis of Philadelphia
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board policy requiring the Chair of the Board, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" the proposal for the following reasons.

proposals.title: Item 5 – Shareholder Proposal on Shareholder Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act at a fully attended meeting to act by written consent.
